headline: Ahead of Deadline, 30 Insurance Companies Still Lack Capital
summary: 30 insurance companies have not yet met minimum equity requirements ahead of the 31 December 2026 deadline. The shortfall is reported ahead of the compliance date.
why: Minimum capital rules protect policyholders, and insurers that fall short may need recapitalisation, merger or other remedies.
original_headline: Jelang Deadline, Masih Ada 30 Perusahaan Asuransi Kurang Modal
